summary: Iteration 55: Reels/Explore Page Feature Testing - ALL CORE TESTS PASSED. Verified the new Instagram Reels-style vertical scrolling product feed at /reels. Full-screen product cards with clean images, action buttons (Like, Cart, Share), product info at bottom, vertical snap scrolling, and navigation links in both mobile menu and desktop nav.

issues: Clipboard API throws 'Write permission denied' error in some browsers without HTTPS/user gesture. The code handles this gracefully with a fallback toast 'Link copied!' but the error overlay appears briefly in development/testing environments.

critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED: /reels route added to App.js with hideChrome=true (no header/footer/booster)
VERIFIED: Full-screen layout with fixed inset-0 bg-black z-50
VERIFIED: Back button (ArrowLeft) at top-left navigates back using navigate(-1)
VERIFIED: 'EXPLORE' title displayed at top center with uppercase tracking
VERIFIED: Vertical snap scrolling works with snap-y snap-mandatory
VERIFIED: Right-side action buttons: Like (heart), Cart (bag), Share - all with data-testid
VERIFIED: Cart button adds product to cart using existing addToCart from CartContext - toast 'Added to cart' appears
VERIFIED: Share button copies link to clipboard (with fallback toast 'Link copied!')
VERIFIED: Clicking product image navigates to /product/{id} detail page
VERIFIED: Product info at bottom: name, price (bold), MRP (strikethrough), discount %, LOW STOCK badge
VERIFIED: Carousel dots appear at top when product has multiple images (totalSlides > 1)
VERIFIED: Desktop nav has 'Explore' link between 'All Products' and 'Partner with Us'
VERIFIED: Mobile menu has 'Explore' link with Clapperboard icon below 'Shop All Products'
VERIFIED: Progress indicator on right side shows current position (up to 20 products)
